dayStartHour.description:
A logical day starts at this local hour: a 01:00 session counts to the evening it started in.
Default 4; a whole number, 0 .. 23.

Takes a whole number 0 .. 23. Default: 4.

weekStart.description:
The first day of the week: 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday. Default 1.

Takes a whole number 1 .. 7. Default: 1.

sessionBreakMin.description:
Away at least this long ends the session (a lock or a suspend always does).
Minutes. Default 5; a whole number, 0 .. 1440.

Takes a whole number 0 .. 1440. Default: 5.

maxBackdateS.description:
An idle feed never removes more than this many seconds.
Seconds. Default 900; a whole number, 0 .. 86400.

Takes a whole number 0 .. 86400. Default: 900.

flushS.description:
While active, the day's totals are written to disk every this many seconds (when they changed).
Default 300; a whole number, 1 .. 86400.

Takes a whole number 1 .. 86400. Default: 300.

checkS.description:
While active: how often a suspend nobody announced is looked for (and the flush clock's tick).
Seconds. Default 60; a whole number, 1 .. 86400.

Takes a whole number 1 .. 86400. Default: 60.

digest.description:
Monday's toast with last week's total. Default true.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

ignore.description:
Classes that are not recorded as an app (their time counts as the desktop's). A list of window classes. Default [].

Takes a list of texts. Default: [].

aliases.description:
class -> class, applied before recording: two classes that are one app. { "<class>": "<class>", ... }. Default {}.

Default: {}.

names.description:
class -> display name, for the digest only (the shell names apps from their desktop entries). { "<class>": "<name>", ... }.
Default {}.

Default: {}.

terminals.description:
Classes whose foreground program is recorded (its process name only, read from /proc): the faint names beside a terminal's
row. A list of window classes. Default the six below.

Takes a list of texts. Default: ["kitty","foot","Alacritty","com.mitchellh.ghostty","org.wezfurlong.wezterm","org.kde.konsole"].
